name: Marcus
label: Artist-focused listener avoiding AI
who: I track my Wrapped and top artists closely, and I want recommendations to reflect the artists I actually listen to. I cancelled my subscription over AI-generated songs showing up in my recommendations, and I review my Discover Weekly by hand to avoid them.
value_for_money: Says the money paid does not reach artists well, which makes a subscription hard to justify [29]. Still says it is worth keeping the discovery and that you get what you pay for [12]. Cancelled over AI content rather than over price [35][36].
loyalty: Stays for a library of about 3,000 songs and the listening history behind Wrapped [29][2]. Cancelled over AI-generated songs and says they wish they could disable Discover Weekly [35][30].
pain_points: AI-generated songs appear on Discover Weekly and recommendations
Recommendations keep repeating the same songs and spread artists out too much
Wrapped and top-artist lists include artists they never chose
Cannot block one song while keeping an artist
likes: Radio and autoplay suggestions that feel on-point
Monthly listeners feature to find smaller artists
Algorithm that works for obscure music
reasons_to_stay: They have a library of about 3,000 songs and years of listening history that they are reluctant to leave [29][2]. They still value radio and autoplay suggestions [7] and the monthly listeners feature for finding smaller artists [19].
tone: Blunt and sardonic, with strong opinions about AI and artists, often using sarcasm.
